summary: This batch proves the operational report dimensions used for retail sales, dealer sales and available vehicle stock. The reports consistently preserve model/colour and vehicle-unit identifiers.

observed: Cash sales can be filtered by date range, model and colour.
Report includes invoice/reference identifiers, customer identity/contact, item/model, colour, chassis and amount.
Engine number is not visible in this particular cash-sale report grid.
inferred: The report is intended for daily/period retail bike-sale tracking rather than full accounting detail.
unknowns: Whether all sale lines appear or one row per invoice
Tax/discount columns are not shown here

observed: Dealer sales can be filtered by dealer and date range.
Account name, model, colour, chassis, engine and amount are reported.
Comp No and Reg No are explicit report columns.
inferred: Comp No may represent company/commission/complaint or another internal identifier; the screenshot does not define it.
unknowns: Whether Amount is gross or net

observed: Available stock is reportable at chassis/engine-unit level.
Model and colour filters are provided.
Category, brand, chassis, engine and amount are the visible stock dimensions.
A special ONLY 30-JUN STOCK action exists with an adjacent Generate Sheet action.
inferred: The 30-Jun-specific view may support fiscal year-end stock reporting/valuation.
unknowns: Meaning of Amount in stock report

cross_image_findings: Cash-sale, dealer-sale and stock reports all retain vehicle-unit identity, confirming chassis/engine tracking is central to the Bike system.
Dealer Sale report includes both chassis and engine; Cash Sale report exposes chassis but not engine in this view.
The dedicated 30-Jun stock action is likely a statutory/year-end operational reporting requirement and should be investigated before replacement.
preliminary_erpnext_relevance: Standard ERPNext serial-number/stock reporting should be evaluated for chassis/engine tracking.
Custom reports may still be needed for dealership-specific filters and year-end stock formats.
